mapper.insert: INSERT INTO session (id, title, agent_id, user_id, token_limit, used_tokens, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{agentId}, #{userId}, #{tokenLimit}, #{usedTokens}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, agent_id, user_id, token_limit, used_tokens, created_at, updated_at FROM session WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC
